title: Include requested ingredients absent from the inventory
description: The pantry.py planner compares a requested shopping mapping with current inventory. An inventory membership filter accidentally omits ingredients that are entirely absent. Repair plan_shortfall(requested, available). Both inputs are mappings with at most 100 keys; keys are arbitrary Unicode strings (including empty), matched exactly and case-sensitively; values are whole-number JSON quantities from 0 through 1000000. Whole-number JSON values mean finite integral numbers after JSON transport, excluding booleans; no Python int-versus-float distinction is promised. None/null, nonintegral numbers, other shapes, and inputs outside the stated bounds are outside this retained contract.

requirements.text: For every requested item that is also present in available, its returned quantity is max(requested quantity minus available quantity, 0), including an explicit zero when stock meets or exceeds demand.
The output has exactly the requested keys. An item absent from available uses zero available units; available-only keys never appear. An empty request returns {}.
Leave both requested and available mappings unchanged in content, including when demand exceeds stock or an item has no stock entry.

provenance: Original independent AI-authored batch-preparation library; author job repo05, repository owned-v2-r05; CC0-1.0. No upstream code or data.
